name: Zhengquan Sun
description: Zhengquan Sun — research on autonomous driving safety, physical adversarial object generation, and multimodal scene reconstruction.
about: Zhengquan Sun is a Ph.D. student at Zhongguancun Laboratory and Beihang University

My research focuses on the safety evaluation of autonomous driving models using multimodal sensor data, with particular interests in physical adversarial object generation and feed-forward multimodal scene reconstruction.

publications.title: MiuGS: Modality-Integrated Unified Gaussian Representation for Physical Adversarial Object Generation in 3D Detection
publications.summary: A shared 3D Gaussian representation for generating adversarial objects with consistent camera and LiDAR observations, supporting the robustness evaluation of multimodal 3D detectors.
